title: iberodes commutata
intro: Iberodes commutata, commonly known as Iberis amara, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Iberis amara include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, wounds, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Iberis amara include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
